## Summary

**Do not include exploit details, PoCs, or affected URLs here.**

Security vulnerabilities must be reported privately via GitHub's
**private security advisory** (see [SECURITY.md](../../blob/main/SECURITY.md)).
Public issues cannot be used for coordinated disclosure.

Use this template only for *non-sensitive* hardening suggestions (e.g. typos
in the threat model, documentation gaps, missing test coverage).
